svg.aria-label: Siam Hossain. Full-stack and AI engineer in Dhaka. BSc CSE, AIUB 2026. I build web apps in TypeScript, C# and Python, and LLM features with guardrails and tests. Three of my tools run at local businesses. Open to full-time, remote and contract work.
